title: Plotter
description: Caravaggio's Basket of Fruit redrawn by a pen plotter on cream paper, in black for tone and a second pen for the warm fruit. Turn the dial and the sheet is re-plotted row by row as hatch, waves, contours, stipple or one long spiral; swap the pens, or drop in your own photo.
intent: One image, five hands: every line width comes from a distance field weighted by the tone beneath it, so a single dial changes how the drawing is made, and the plotter re-draws the sheet under its gantry instead of cross-fading.
